_comment: KOL tiers (Indonesian naming). Follower + est-reach bands are REFERENCE ranges only — any number derived from them must be rendered as 'est.' (provenance=estimate), never as fact. Rates are never derived here; they come from the roster.

tiers.label: Mikro (Micro)
tiers.best_for: Niche communities, strong conversion, cost-efficient reach

tiers.label: Makro (Macro)
tiers.best_for: Category authority, broad awareness, premium positioning

tiers.label: Mega
tiers.best_for: Mass awareness, launch moments, cultural reach
